info.title: MarketAI Domain API
info.description: Contract for the FastAPI domain service reached through the BFF catch-all proxy (spec §4.10, §6). Extracted from the running FastAPI app by scripts/generate_openapi.py — do not hand-edit paths or schemas without also updating the corresponding /api/v1/* route.

post.description:
Reserve both lines under one Operation and queue the scan Job; the
same ``Idempotency-Key`` replays the same scan (never deduplicated by
date). Poll the Operation or the scan itself.

get.description: The Workspace's scans, newest first (at most 50).

post.description: Both lines of the maximum a scan can cost, and the keys it needs; reserves nothing.

get.description: Status and stage, per-target progress, step evidence, both costs and key versions.

The scan's observations with their origins and relevance. Filters: a
competitor (its own page included), ``role`` (``self`` = the product's
own page), ``origin_kind``, days running, display format and the
relevance in effect (``unassessed``: not judged yet).
Every relevance revision of one observation, oldest first.

post.description:
Set one observation's relevance (Owner or Member): a new revision,
audited with the actor; earlier revisions stay in its history.

Confirm or change one observation's tags (Owner or Member): a new
revision, audited with the actor; the AI's suggestion stays in history.

get.description: Every tags revision of one observation, oldest first, with the frozen vocabulary.

The advertisers the scan's keywords found and its discover step
recommends (``relevant`` or ``adjacent``), with each one's state.

post.description:
Accept (Owner or Member: a new competitor confirmed by the ads' page
ID, no resolve, no charge) or reject one recommendation; appended and
audited with the actor. Deciding what is already in effect answers it.

Paid (Owner or Member, Spend Guardrail applies): reserve ``cluster:1``
for a Job of its own, which appends a new clusters revision and freezes
once. Poll the Operation or the scan's ``reclusters``.

get.description: What reclustering can cost at most; reserves nothing.

post.description:
Owner only: mark a pending page "charged" or "not charged"; its cost
is settled accordingly and the page is fetched again on resume.

Continue a ``partial``, ``failed`` or ``uncertain`` scan under the same
ID from its stored cursors: a new Job reserves only what is left and
first reconciles any ``uncertain`` page by the free credit balance.

get.description: What resuming would reserve: the remaining pages and LLM steps only.

post.description:
Freeze the revisions in effect now (free, no LLM, any member).
Unchanged revisions answer the existing snapshot (``created`` false).

get.description: The scan's snapshots, newest first; ``current`` marks the scan's own.
One snapshot with its frozen content (what a plan cites).

The summary of the scan's current snapshot (or ``snapshot_id``):
clusters, unclustered, adjacent, long-running and own-page observations,
dimension counts and the AI's one-sentence conclusion.

post.description: Add a competitor; a link with a page id confirms it at once.

post.description: Owner only. Archived competitors are not scanned; history stays.
Append a confirmation revision binding the competitor to one page.

Status, the vocabulary, the AI suggestion and the confirmed tags.

post.description:
Confirm (or correct) the tags: the image gets the concept identity a
generated image with the same values carries.

Idempotent regeneration-draft creation (Issue #49 Task 7, spec §5.4).

Fingerprinted on ``(version_id, intent, prompt_overrides,
qc_attempt_id)`` via ``compute_fingerprint`` -- replaying the same
``Idempotency-Key`` against the same request returns the original
Draft (``generation_draft`` resource, spec §5.4 sync resource path); the
same key against a different request raises ``IdempotencyKeyReusedError``
(409, handled app-wide, matching ``create_review``'s pattern above).

Idempotent review creation (Issue #49 Task 5, spec §0.3/§5.4).

Fingerprinted on ``(version_id, review_value, reason,
supersedes_review_id)`` via ``compute_fingerprint`` -- replaying the same
``Idempotency-Key`` against the same request returns the original
review; the same key against a different request raises
``IdempotencyKeyReusedError`` (409, handled app-wide). A head guard in
``app.generation.review.create_review`` rejects (409
``effective_review_exists``) a review that omits
``supersedes_review_id`` while an effective review head already exists.

get.description: The Workspace's effective generation defaults (any member).

post.description:
Freeze a selection into an ExportPackage and enqueue the Worker
Job that builds its ZIP (Issue #49 Task 9). Returns 202 with the
package/Operation ids the browser's ``useExportFlow`` polls -- the
``Location`` header points at the Operation, matching the async-command
convention every other 202 route in this router follows.

get.description:
Current ExportPackage state (Issue #49 Task 9): the browser's
``useExportFlow`` polls this alongside the Operation to recover state
across a refresh, independent of the 202 response's Operation-state
``state``.

post.description:
Same pattern as the AssetVersion download-intent route above
(Issue #49 Task 2): the committed ZIP ref is resolved server-side
(``export_module.resolve_export_blob_ref``), never supplied by the
browser, and re-resolved fresh on every call -- replays included -- so
a replay still fails closed if the package's blob somehow became
unavailable between requests.

Atomic review-summary regeneration batch (Issue #49 Task 7, spec
§0.3/§0.4). Groups ``candidate_version_ids`` by stable-dimension-
signature and creates one regeneration Draft per group -- 2 variants for
``action == "regenerate_needs_changes"``, 3 for
``"supplement_approved"`` (``app.generation.regeneration.
create_review_summary_regeneration``). Browser Task 10's
``ReviewSummary`` is the consumer.

Idempotent the same way ``create_regeneration_draft`` above is, except
the resource this binds is the whole batch: ``resource_id`` is the
*first* created Draft's id (in the deterministic, by-signature order
the domain call returns them) -- ``response_resource_id`` is a bounded
``VARCHAR(100)`` and joining every created Draft id would overflow it
past two signature groups (Issue #49 Task 7 review, Finding 2), so the
full ordered id list instead rides along on each Draft's own
``combination_strategy_json`` (``regeneration_module.
create_review_summary_regeneration`` writes it as ``batch_draft_ids``).
A replay looks up that first Draft, reads the sibling ids off it, and
reconstructs each batch item fresh from its persisted Draft
(``regeneration_module.batch_item_from_draft``) rather than re-running
the grouping -- so a replay is stable even if intervening reviews would
change how a fresh call groups the same candidates.

get.description:
One page of a Run's items, each with its bound AssetVersion's signed
thumbnail link when it has one (Issue #159). The synchronous projection
runs off the event loop; only the page actually returned gets its
thumbnails signed, after the session has closed.

post.description: Create/replay and enqueue recovery for an uncertain Operation.
Consume a fresh confirmation and enqueue the durable PAUSED saga.

Queue a local check of the data source (#383, ``app.library.connection_checks``).

The Worker takes the execution mode from the effective version;
``execution_mode`` is only recorded beside it. A replayed Idempotency-Key
returns the Operation it created, wherever that has got to; the same key
for another data source is ``409 idempotency_key_reused``.

get.description: One finished check: ``check_id`` is the ``resource_id`` of its Operation's result.

post.description:
Publish a released reference object as a ReferenceAssetVersion and,
optionally, bind it to a product/person Draft.

``reference_asset`` is Member-publishable (contract §4) and every byte of
the version content is server-derived gate evidence -- see
``service.promote_reference_object``. Owner-only publish types are
untouched -- this command can only ever create ``reference_asset``
entries.

Issue a signed direct link for a published reference's controlled derivative.

Same seam as generated-asset downloads (``app.generation.v1_router``):
the derivative is resolved server-side from the Version, an immutable
``DownloadIntentRecord`` is written (idempotently), and the ``BlobStore``
adapter signs a short-lived GET the browser opens against the storage
origin. Nothing binary passes through FastAPI or the BFF.

Recheck and publish an isolated output whose entire frozen QC plan
has passed (spec §2E/§2H). Refused while any frozen check is missing --
the caller must run `authorize_localization_isolated_qc` first and wait
for it.

Admit only the frozen external QC steps a preserved isolated output
still needs (spec §2E/§2H). Owner or Member, exactly like the other
recovery commands -- and, as with them, the role that reaches the domain
service is the one signed into the delegated identity token, never a
client-supplied value.

get.description: Each product's current brand baseline, for choosing the exact version a plan freezes.

put.description:
Append the next immutable version (If-Match: the current version, 0 for the first).

Plans, recipes and QC keep the exact version they reference; this never rewrites them.

get.description:
Preview one QC kind's cost. Without `kind` (clients from before the split) this is the single-image quote.
`strategy_language` is the requester's interface language, used only when the round's plan has none (J-43).

The Workspace's products with display name, main image and latest Run,
newest first -- the read behind the product home, product names on
Generation pages and the New Draft product picker.

Published product/model references, including unavailable items and draft conflicts.

Bind a released, promoted object/version after the governed upload flow.

No binary ingestion or in-request file gate. Publishes one ProductVersion

Parse, validate and match result rows into a preview (nothing is

Count the accepted rows and recompute the learnings. ``409
preview_stale``: the evidence changed since the preview -- the import

get.description:
The Meta modes this request's identity may select (see
``app.platform.meta_mode_auth``). Root-level -- no ``meta_mode`` path
segment, since the point is to discover which modes are permitted
before choosing one (spec §3.11).

``operation_id`` deliberately avoids the substring "meta" (beyond the
path itself): ``test_scale_openapi_has_no_meta_mutation_surface`` (ADR
0008, "Scale never performs Meta writes") asserts no Scale operationId
contains it, to keep a real Meta-mutation route from ever leaking into
Scale's contract undetected. This route only reads which Meta modes an
identity may select -- it performs no Meta write -- but a literal
"meta" substring would still trip that guard.

Discovery only (spec §4.4) -- never gates any command. Returns
confirmed Winner Decisions currently eligible for enrollment that have
no live Enrollment yet; a caller still names the exact pair to
:func:`create_scale_enrollment_candidate` below, which independently
re-validates everything.

AIQCErrorDetail.description:
Why a returned output was refused (#295): an `error-<reason>` code, the field path, the validator's problem and a
bounded excerpt with the hash and length of the whole output. Never the request, its headers or a credential.

AdviceDispositionRequest.description:
``kind`` is validated by the domain layer
(``app.scale.advice.create_disposition`` rejects everything but
``acknowledged``/``dismissed`` with ``unsupported_disposition_kind``,
mapped to 422 by ``app.scale.v1_router``'s problem handler) rather than
re-validated here, so that single rejection reason stays authoritative.

AssetGalleryFacets.description:
Server-computed facets over the full matching Workspace dataset, not
just the currently loaded page (spec §0.2). ``reviews`` (Task 5) is
computed from the supersession-aware effective-review projection, with
a "no effective review" bucket surfaced as the value ``"unreviewed"``.
``qc_states`` and ``tags`` stay empty until Task 6 lands their backing
columns.

AssetGalleryPage.description:
``GET /generation/assets`` (Issue #49 Task 3, spec §0.2). Replaces the
generic ``Page[Any]`` envelope with a typed page carrying server-computed
facets and collection-level ``allowed_actions`` (export eligibility for
the current scope).

AssetQCAttemptSummary.description:
Row of ``AssetVersionDetail.qc_attempts`` -- QC attempt history
(spec §0.2's "QC attempt history + latest_qc_attempt_id"). Since Issue
#169 it carries the VLM check's summary, reasons and per-check verdicts,
how many consecutive failures this combination has had, and which human
quality the failure projected (``needs_changes`` / ``rejected``).

AssetQCCheckSummary.description:
One check of a QC attempt (Issue #169): a must-match item, product
presence, text artifacts or reference readability, with its verdict
(``pass``/``fail``/``uncertain``/``skip``) and the Chinese reason.

AssetReview.description: Row of ``AssetVersionDetail.reviews`` and the create-review result.

AssetThumbnailLink.description:
A short-lived signed GET for an AssetVersion's gallery thumbnail
(Issue #159, ``app.generation.thumbnails``).

Embedded per item by the two list projections that render tiles
(``AssetVersionSummary.thumbnail``, ``GenerationRunItemSummary.thumbnail``)
so a page of tiles costs one list request plus one small GET per tile.
It is the 512px-long-edge derivative, never the original -- Asset
Detail, the Lightbox and exports keep the download-intent path for
originals. ``null`` whenever the version has no derivative (legacy rows
awaiting backfill, a derivative that could not be produced, a RunItem
that has produced nothing yet); the browser then falls back to the
original through the download-intent route.

AssetVersionDetail.description:
``GET /generation/asset-versions/{id}``
(``asset_queries.get_asset_version_detail``, Issue #49 Task 4, spec
§0.2). Extends ``AssetVersionSummary``'s fields with full provenance:
seed, prompt, append-only ``reviews[]``, QC attempt history, and
parent/children lineage. Browser Task 8's ``LightboxModal`` consumes
this.

Raw object keys and committed storage-version identifiers are
deliberately never exposed to the browser -- downloads go through a
signed DownloadIntent, not a raw blob reference.
``stable_dimension_signature`` and ``mock_evidence`` stay ``None`` --
no backing column exists yet. ``contextual_conclusions`` (Task 6, spec
§0.7) is every non-revoked, fully-anchored
``ContextualExperimentConclusion`` for this exact AssetVersion, each
carrying its own full context. ``review_head_id``/
``effective_review_value`` apply Task 5's supersession-aware head-review
rule (spec §0.3) -- a ``cleared`` head still sets ``review_head_id`` but
projects ``effective_review_value`` to ``None``.

AssetVersionLineageEntry.description:
One ``parent``/``children`` lineage entry (spec §0.2/§0.6): the exact
AssetVersion id plus the regeneration intent that produced this edge --
the *child* version's producing ``RunItemRecord.intent_kind``, not a
property of the parent. ``intent`` is ``None`` when the producing
RunItem cannot be resolved (e.g. legacy data).

AssetVersionSeed.description:
Requested vs. effective seed for one AssetVersion's generation call,
plus the reason the effective seed is unavailable/differs (spec §0.2).

AssetVersionSummary.description:
Row of ``GET /generation/assets`` (``asset_queries.list_asset_versions``,
Issue #49 Task 3, spec §0.2).

``id`` is the AssetVersion id -- the exact-version identity the browser
reviews/regenerates/downloads against, matching
``app.generation.review``'s exact-version anchor.

``stable_dimension_signature`` and ``mock_evidence`` are always
``None`` for now -- no column backs either of them yet.
``contextual_conclusion`` (Task 6, spec §0.7) is populated only when
the request supplied ``experiment_context``; otherwise it stays
``None`` -- it is never a global property of the AssetVersion.
``effective_review_value`` applies Task 5's supersession-aware
head-review rule (``app.generation.review.project_effective_review``,
spec §0.3); ``latest_qc_state`` is the latest
``AssetQCAttemptRecord.state``. ``thumbnail`` (Issue #159) is the
version's signed thumbnail link, or ``None`` when it has no derivative.

AttemptCost.description: Cost sub-object inside AttemptSummary: Decimal string + currency.

AttemptSummary.description: Latest provider attempt state for a RunItem.

BalanceCheck.description:
Worst total-variation distance of another factor between the two
compared groups (>= 0.25 ``imbalanced``, >= 0.5 ``confounded``).

BoardAppearanceSummary.description: Round-level product appearance; `pending_combination_ids` lists combinations with a pending execution.

BoardExecution.description:
One image of a combination, or an ungenerated placeholder without an AssetVersion ID.

`thumbnail` (include_board_thumbnails only) is the version's signed 512px derivative for the tile; null for
placeholders and for versions without one, where the tile falls back to the original through the download intent.

BoardProductAppearance.description:
Whether this execution's visible product appearance can be checked against frozen, current verified photos.

`pending_verification` (外观待核实) keeps product_fidelity unknown. A photo or its verified status is never
evidence for certification, hidden performance or ad effect.

BrandKitContent.description: The immutable stored version: the logo is resolved to its exact reference identity.

BrandKitRef.description: An exact, immutable brand baseline version that a plan and its recipes freeze.

BrandLogoInput.description: A product reference item the product settings marked role=logo (#226).

CandidateCreateRequest.description:
Wire shape for creating one short-lived Enrollment Candidate (spec
§4.4). ``winner_decision_id``/``delivery_target_id`` are still raw
identifiers here -- that is expected: this is the one endpoint whose
entire job is proving a caller-named pair is currently a valid lineage,
before handing back the opaque, narrow-scoped candidate id every other
Scale write actually consumes.

CommandImpactProjection.description:
Response from ``POST .../publish-impact``, ``archive-impact``, ``withdraw-impact``.

The browser presents this to the user, then echoes ``impact_id`` +
``impact_hash`` back to the matching command for atomic verification.

Competitor.description:
A competitor of a product (or ``role=self``, the product's own page).
``input_kind`` is how it was added; ``can_resolve`` says whether a
name search is possible (a name, or the alias of a pasted page link).

Two read-only projections from the product's scans, neither a call nor
a change to the confirmation: ``observed_page_name`` is the advertiser
name of the confirmed page's newest observation (a link confirms a page
without its name; null until a scan sees the page), and
``last_scanned_at`` is when the newest finished scan (``completed``,
``partial``, ``failed`` or ``uncertain``) that included this competitor
finished (null when none has).

CompetitorAd.description:
One observation (spec §5.3): what was seen in the Meta Ad Library,
never what works (ADR 0014). ``competitor_ids`` are the competitors whose
page it was fetched from (projected from its ``page:`` origins);
``role`` is ``self`` when the ad is the product's own page's: fetched
from that page, or its advertiser page is the page a ``role=self``
competitor of this scan confirmed.
``field_sources`` names the provider field each value came from.
``relevance`` is null until the filter step (or a member) judged it;
``tags`` until the tag step (or a member) tagged it.

CompetitorAdAssessmentEvidence.description: Which ``llm_chat`` call answered an ``ai`` revision (its batch is ``call_name``).

CompetitorAdAssessmentList.description: An observation's relevance revisions, oldest first; ``current`` is the one in effect.

CompetitorAdCard.description: Card 0 is the snapshot's own creative; ``snapshot.cards[i]`` is card ``i + 1``.

CompetitorAdMedia.description:
One archived image or video poster (video files are never archived).
``source_url`` is the provider link without its signature; ``expires_at``
is when the signed link stopped working (``oe=``).

CompetitorAdOrigin.description: A path the observation was found by: a competitor's page or a keyword.

CompetitorAdPage.description: One page of observations, longest-running first; ``total`` counts every match.

CompetitorAdRelevance.description:
The relevance revision in effect (spec §7.1), AI inference until a
member flips it (ADR 0014). ``source``: ``ai`` (the scan's filter step;
``confidence`` and a one-sentence ``reason`` in the scan's language),
``rule`` (a keyword-only observation the §7.1 rules judged ``unrelated``
without the LLM; ``rule`` names it) or ``user`` (a flip).

CompetitorAdRelevanceFlip.description: A member's verdict on one observation; flipping back is one more revision.

CompetitorAdTagAssessment.description:
One append-only tags revision: the AI's suggestion (``ai_suggestion``;
per factor a value, confidence and reason in the scan's language, a
one-sentence ``summary`` and the card images it saw) or a member's
confirmation (``created_by``, ``previous``).

CompetitorAdTagList.description:
An observation's tags revisions, oldest first; ``current`` is the one
in effect. ``vocabulary`` is null until the tag step froze one.

CompetitorAdTags.description:
The tags revision in effect: the scan's AI suggestion
(``ai_suggestion``, ``source=ai``) until a member confirms or changes it
(``source=user``). ``value_id`` null is "none of these".

CompetitorAdTagsConfirm.description:
A member's tags for one observation, against the scan's frozen
vocabulary: one value per factor (``value_id`` null or ``none`` = none of
these); factors left out are "none". Confirming the AI's values as they
are is a revision too.

CompetitorAdThumbnail.description: A short-lived signed GET of the 512px derivative (not downloadable as a reference).

CompetitorCandidate.description:
A page a name search returned, scored by spec §4.2.

``rank`` is the order after scoring and the domain probe (0 first);
``provider_rank`` is the provider's order. ``name_match`` compares the
normalized names (case, spaces and punctuation ignored); ``alias_match``
compares with the alias of a pasted ``facebook.com/<alias>`` link.
``domain_hit`` is null when no official site was given or the page was
not probed. ``avatar`` is the copy the resolve downloaded (free, from
Meta's CDN only), never the provider's signed link; it is served only
while the resolve is running or reusable and never on a confirmation.
It is null when the page has no avatar or the download failed: the
card shows a placeholder.

CompetitorCandidateAvatar.description:
A short-lived signed GET of the resolve's archived copy of a page's
avatar (its 512px derivative), read like a board thumbnail.

CompetitorClaimCluster.description:
One buying claim (AI inference, ``ai_inference``): its members as of
the snapshot (observations no longer relevant left it), the advertisers
(``role=self`` marked; ``advertiser_count`` leaves them out) and the
longest days running.

CompetitorConfirmRequest.description:
Either a candidate of a reusable resolve (``resolve_job_id`` +
``page_id``) or a page link carrying a page id (``page_url``: a
``profile.php?id=`` link or an Ad Library ``view_all_page_id`` link).
Confirming the page that is already confirmed from the same source
returns that revision instead of appending another.

CompetitorConfirmation.description:
The latest confirmed page: an append-only revision. ``source`` is
``link`` (a pasted link with a page id), ``auto`` (the resolve matched
by exact name and domain, or by the pasted alias) or ``user``.
``candidate`` is the resolve's card for that page as it was confirmed
(without the avatar).

CompetitorCreateRequest.description:
One input of spec §4.1 in ``input``: a Facebook page link
(``facebook.com/<alias>``, ``/profile.php?id=<id>``), an Ad Library link
with ``view_all_page_id``, or a name. ``website`` (a URL or a bare
domain) is the official site a resolve compares landing pages with.
``role=self`` adds the product's own page as a baseline.

CompetitorDimensionCount.description:
Per value, relevant observations a member confirmed it on
(``confirmed``) and ones that only carry it as an AI suggestion.

CompetitorDimensionNone.description:
Relevant observations with no value of this factor: ``confirmed``
none, ``suggested`` none, or no tags at all (``missing``).

CompetitorDiscovery.description:
One recommended advertiser: found only by the scan's keywords, past
the §7.1 rules (never a personal account; no avatar is ever shown) and
judged ``relevant`` or ``adjacent`` by its ``discover:i`` call -- AI
inference with a one-sentence ``reason`` in the scan's ``language``.
``observation_count`` counts its keyword-only observations in this scan.
``state``: ``open`` (never decided, or the latest decision is an
``accept`` whose competitor no longer has the page on the product's
list -- archived or re-confirmed elsewhere -- so it is decided again);
``accepted`` (the latest decision, its competitor still on the list);
``rejected``; ``competitor`` (already on the list, added another way).
``decision`` is the product's latest decision, in effect or not;
``competitor_id`` is the listed competitor that has the page, if any.
``library_url`` opens its page in the Meta Ad Library.

CompetitorDiscoveryDecision.description:
A member's decision on one recommended advertiser: append-only, per
product. ``competitor_id`` is the competitor an ``accept`` created. The
newest decision counts: a ``reject`` always, an ``accept`` only while
that competitor still has the page on the product's list.

CompetitorDiscoveryDecisionRequest.description:
``accept`` adds the advertiser as a competitor confirmed by the page
ID from its ads (no resolve, no charge); ``reject`` keeps it out of the
product's later scans. ``reason`` is optional.

CompetitorDiscoveryDecisionResult.description:
The recommendation after the decision, the decision in effect, and the
competitor an accept created (null for a reject).

CompetitorDiscoveryList.description:
A scan's recommendations, most observations first. ``status`` and
``reason`` are the discover step's, which runs last on a scan with
keywords (``skipped`` + ``no_keywords`` without any, ``no_candidates``
when they found no advertiser outside the list; ``pending`` until it
runs; ``partial`` or ``failed`` with ``calls_failed``,
``ordinals_exhausted`` or the ``llm_chat`` code that stopped it, which a
resume finishes). ``advertisers`` is
the frozen table (at most ``max_discover_advertisers``; ``over_cap``
more were left out), ``judged`` how many have an answer, ``unrelated``
how many were judged unrelated and are not listed.

CompetitorPageProbe.description:
One ``probe`` call: the first page of a candidate's active ads.
``total_active_ads`` is the provider's own count; ``landing_domains``
are the registrable domains the sampled ads link to.

CompetitorResolution.description:
A resolve: ``queued`` -> ``running`` -> ``completed``; ``failed``
(the search failed, or a 402/401/403 stopped the probes -- candidates
already found stay listed) or ``uncertain`` (a call's outcome is
unknown; nothing is resent). ``waits`` counts how often it queued
behind another market-data job on the same key (spec §5.1). A finished
resolve is ``reusable`` for confirmation until ``expires_at`` (72 hours).
``auto_confirmed`` is true when it confirmed the page itself (exact name
and domain hit, or the alias of a pasted page link).

CompetitorResolveCost.description:
What the resolve's calls cost: settled from each call's
``credits_charged``. ``usd`` is real money (``"0"`` under Mock).

CompetitorResolveQuote.description:
The maximum a resolve can cost: ``page_search`` x 1 + ``probe`` x 3
(fewer probes are made when fewer candidates qualify; the rest is
released). ``max_usd`` is what the Workspace pays: ``"0"`` under
Controlled Mock, whose ``simulated_usd`` is an estimate only (null when
the deployment has no price table). ``available_modes`` lists ``byok``
only when a ``market_data`` key is bound and prices are configured;
otherwise ``byok_unavailable_code`` says why, with the values its copy
interpolates in ``byok_unavailable_params`` (the missing ``operations``
of ``market_data_price_operation_missing``).

CompetitorResolveRequest.description:
Start a resolve. ``execution_mode`` defaults to the quote's default
(``byok`` when available, else ``mock``); ``country`` (ISO 3166-1
alpha-2) is the market the probes read active ads in.

CompetitorScan.description:
A scan: ``queued`` -> ``running`` -> ``completed`` | ``partial`` (some
pages succeeded, some failed or ran out of credits) | ``failed`` (no page
succeeded) | ``uncertain`` (a page's outcome is unknown and not yet
reconciled). ``stage`` is the last completed step. ``can_resume`` when
pages are left, a page awaits reconciliation, or a judgment step did not
finish (a ``completed`` scan whose AI key was refused mid-way, say).
``waits`` counts how often it queued behind another market-data job on
the same key (spec §5.1). ``snapshot_id`` is the snapshot of the
revisions in effect as of the last freeze.

CompetitorScanBalanceCheck.description:
The automatic reconciliation (spec §5.1): the free credit-balance
compared with the last successful call before the page, less the charges
known since. ``difference`` 0 settles "not charged", exactly 1 "charged";
anything else (``reason``) is left to the Owner.

CompetitorScanCost.description: What the scan cost so far: both lines and their sum (real money).

CompetitorScanCredential.description:
A key a real scan needs: ``market_data`` (ScrapeCreators) or
``generation`` (the AI key ``llm_chat`` uses). ``code`` says why it is
not ready.

CompetitorScanLlmQuote.description:
Line (b): the LLM maximum, reserved per call name and released for
every call name the scan does not use.

CompetitorScanLlmQuoteLine.description:
One LLM step: ``calls`` numbered call names, each reserved at
``quote_llm_chat``'s maximum for its token ceilings.

CompetitorScanMarketDataCost.description: Settled from each call's ``credits_charged`` (and reconciled pages).

CompetitorScanMarketDataQuote.description:
Line (a): the provider's maximum. ``max_usd`` is real money (``"0"``
under Mock, whose ``simulated_usd`` is an estimate, null without a price
table).

CompetitorScanMedia.description: Media archiving: one entry per card image or video poster.

CompetitorScanParams.description: The scan's frozen parameters; first release: Meta, active ads only.

CompetitorScanQuote.description:
The two-line maximum of a scan (``kind=scan``) or of what is left of
one (``kind=resume``: remaining pages, the unused refresh quota and the
LLM steps without an answer). ``available_modes`` lists ``byok`` only
when both keys are ready and prices are configured; otherwise
``byok_unavailable_code`` (and its ``byok_unavailable_params``) says
why. ``max_usd`` is the sum of both lines.

CompetitorScanQuoteLine.description: One provider operation: ``calls`` x its credits x the credit price.

CompetitorScanRecluster.description:
A member's paid recluster: its own Operation and Job, ``cluster:1``
reserved at ``max_usd``; when it completes, the new clusters revision
and the snapshot it froze.

CompetitorScanReclusterQuote.description:
What a recluster can cost at most: ``cluster:1`` at
``quote_llm_chat``'s maximum, in the scan's own execution mode.

CompetitorScanReconcileRequest.description: The Owner's verdict on one pending page: did the provider charge it?

CompetitorScanReconciliation.description:
A page whose outcome was lost after the dispatch fence. Its cost is
settled by the automatic check or by the Owner; the page itself is
fetched again as a new attempt.

CompetitorScanRequest.description:
What to scan (spec §5.1). Every competitor must belong to the product,
be active and have a confirmed page; ``role=self`` competitors are
scanned as the baseline. ``keywords`` feed competitor discovery (spec
§8), ``keyword_pages`` pages each. ``max_media_refreshes`` is the quota
of paid ``ad_refresh`` calls for media links that expired.
``max_tagged_ads`` and ``max_discover_advertisers`` cap the LLM steps.
``execution_mode`` defaults to the quote's default (``byok`` when both
keys are ready, else ``mock``). The AI output language is the
initiator's interface language, frozen into ``params.language``.

CompetitorScanResume.description: A resume: same scan, a new Job and Operation, possibly a newer key.

CompetitorScanSnapshot.description:
A snapshot with its frozen ``content`` (``version``
``competitor-snapshot/v1``: ``relevant_ad_ids``, ``judgments``,
``cluster_revision``, ``claim_clusters``, ``unclustered_ad_ids``,
``dimension_counts``, ``long_running_ad_ids``, ``adjacent_ad_ids``,
``self_ad_ids``, ``ads``, ``params``). A refreeze answers ``created``
false when the hash was already frozen.

CompetitorScanSnapshotMeta.description:
A snapshot: the scan's relevant observations and the revisions in
effect, frozen with a hash over the whole content (spec §7.1).
``current`` is the scan's ``snapshot_id``.

CompetitorScanSnapshotSummary.description:
The summary of one snapshot (spec §9): claim clusters, the relevant
observations no cluster holds (``unclustered``: flipped to relevant
since the last clustering), adjacent, long-running (``long_running_days``
or more) and own-page observations, dimension counts and the AI's
conclusion. ``pending_changes`` says a refreeze would make a new
snapshot; ``can_recluster`` that a recluster can be quoted now.

CompetitorScanStepState.description:
One Worker step (spec §5.2). A ``partial`` or ``failed`` filter or tag
step says why in ``reason``: ``calls_failed``, ``ordinals_exhausted``
(more work than reserved call names) or the ``llm_chat`` code that
stopped the run (e.g. ``credential_rejected``; tag and cluster then
record the same code without calling). ``skipped`` reasons:
``no_vocabulary`` (tag: the product has no dimension vocabulary),
``vocabulary_not_frozen`` (tag: a scan admitted before Issue #272),
``no_relevant_observations`` (tag, cluster), ``no_observations`` and
``no_judgments`` (freeze); ``not_implemented`` on scans of releases
before Issue #272. A ``completed`` cluster step with ``reason=answered``
read an earlier run's answer. Discovery (Issue #276) reports its step
on the scan's discoveries, not here.

CompetitorScanTarget.description:
One fetch path: a competitor's confirmed page (``page:<competitor_id>``)
or a keyword (``keyword:<keyword>``). ``pages_fetched`` counts pages
that succeeded; ``exhausted`` means the provider had no further page.
A failed target is fetched again by ``resume`` from its stored cursor.
``page_name`` is the confirmation's, frozen at admission (none for a
link); ``observed_page_name`` is read-only, the advertiser name of the
page's newest observation in the product's scans (null until one).

CompetitorSnapshotAd.description:
An observation as the summary lists it. ``ai_inferred`` is false for
a member's or a rule's relevance (``source`` ``user`` / ``rule``).

CompetitorSnapshotConclusion.description: The AI's one-sentence conclusion of the cited clusters revision (AI inference).

CompetitorTagVocabulary.description: The product's dimension vocabulary as the scan froze it.

CompetitorTagVocabularyFactor.description:
``source`` is ``test_plan``, ``dimension_template`` or
``expression_catalog`` (the expression mechanism catalog, one factor
every product has; Issue #329).

execution_mode.description: Ignored. A data source is checked in its published version's execution mode.

CopyChange.description: Words of the confirmed copy and what the image rendered in their place; either side may be empty.

CostEvidence.description: Spend reservation state for a RunItem's provider call.

execution_mode.description: Ignored. The content-safety execution mode is decided by the server.

safety_scenario.description: Ignored. The controlled-Mock scenario is decided by the server.

credential_state.description: State of the bound CredentialVersion, or null when none is bound.

DataSourceConnectionCheck.description:
``GET /entries/{id}/connection-checks/{check_id}``: one check's evidence (#383).

The conclusion is ``health`` plus ``reason_code``; the Operation that ran
the check is ``succeeded`` whatever it found. ``execution_mode`` is the
checked version's, never the one a client asked for.

DirectionAdd.description: The user's own idea; omitted factors take each factor's first value.

DirectionEdit.description: Edits are limited to the card's text and its factor values.

DownloadGrant.description:
Signed capability returned by a download-intent route (spec §7.4).

The browser never sees an object key or storage credentials -- only a
short-lived signed ``url`` plus enough shape (``kind``, ``headers``,
``content_disposition``) to perform the fetch and save the result.

DraftSummary.description: Shape of ``service._draft_dict`` -- also the ``bind`` command result.

EnrollmentActivateRequest.description:
Issue #86 Task 11: the only field a caller may supply is the id of an
already-consumed-server-side ``ScaleActivationPreviewRecord`` --
``delivery_config``/``episode_context`` (the pre-hardening shape a
browser could use to fabricate any lineage/evidence it liked) are
rejected as unknown fields by ``_Base``'s ``extra="forbid"``, surfacing
as a 422.

EnrollmentCreateRequest.description:
Issue #86 Task 9: the only field a caller may supply is the id of an
already-proven ``ScaleEnrollmentCandidateRecord`` -- every raw Winner/
DeliveryTarget identifier a pre-#86 client sent directly (and
``creator_id``, which the server now derives exclusively from the
verified ``TenantContext``) is rejected as an unknown field by
``_Base``'s ``extra="forbid"``, surfacing as a 422.

EnrollmentEvidenceResponse.description:
Current evidence/readiness for an Enrollment's active Episode --
the accepted-Evaluation projection (spec §3.4 step 3/4), not a raw
evidence snapshot. Reflects only a projection-eligible result that has
already won the structured cursor CAS.

EnrollmentResumeRequest.description:
Issue #86 Task 11: same preview-only shape as
``EnrollmentActivateRequest`` -- resume cannot bypass the preview
protocol (spec §5.3), even when it will end up continuing an
already-open Episode untouched.

EvidenceBasis.description: Confirmed-understanding facts, or an explicit gap; inferences are not evidence.

ExclusionSummary.description: Summary of excluded combinations in a preview.

Expansion.description:
What ``POST /runs {stage: "full"}`` would generate now: the plan's
small/full selection minus combinations the sample Run already produced
(``reused_combinations``, never paid twice).

ExportPackageDetail.description:
``GET /generation/exports/{id}`` result (export.get_export_package).

Recovery/polling shape (Issue #49 Task 9): the browser's ``useExportFlow``
polls this alongside the Operation to recover state across a refresh.
``state`` here is the ExportPackage's own projection
(``pending``/``building``/``ready``/``failed``/``expired``), unlike the
202 response's Operation-state ``state``.

ExportPackageQueued.description:
``POST /generation/exports`` 202 result (Issue #49 Task 9).

``state`` is the authorizing Operation's state (``"queued"`` for a
fresh call, or whatever state a replayed Operation has already reached)
-- not the ExportPackage's own ``pending``/``building``/``ready``/
``failed`` projection, which ``GET /generation/exports/{id}``
(``ExportPackageDetail``) surfaces instead.

ExportSelectorInput.description:
A discriminated ``ExportSelector`` (Issue #49 Task 9, spec §0.4).

Not a strict pydantic discriminated union -- ``kind`` picks which of the
other (all-optional) fields ``app.generation.export._resolve_selector``
actually reads, and that function is the single place that enforces
each kind's own preconditions (e.g. ``winner_only`` requiring
``experiment_context_id``) as a domain ``ExportError`` rather than a
422 schema-validation error, so the response ``code`` stays a stable
domain vocabulary instead of a pydantic error shape.

ExternalCreativeConfirmRequest.description:
The reviewed tags (one per factor; ``value_id`` null or omitted factor
= "none of these"), an optional direction, and whether confirming also
approves the image for tests (default true).

ExternalCreativeCreateRequest.description:
Finalized uploads of purpose ``external_creative`` (PNG/JPEG/WebP,
<= 20 MB each, at most 10) for one product.

ExternalCreativeDetail.description:
``status``: ``queued`` -> ``gating`` -> ``preparing_asset`` ->
``tagging`` -> ``ready`` (suggestion available) -> ``confirmed``; or
``rejected`` (upload gate), ``failed``, ``tagging_failed`` (the asset
exists; tag it by hand). ``asset_code`` (``MK-XXXXXX``) is what a
results sheet matches.

FactorValueRef.description: An existing value (``value_id``) or a new one worded by the user (``label``).

FinalizeUploadResponse.description:
See the note on `UploadIntentResponse` -- the handler returns a
`JSONResponse` directly.

FrozenExpression.description: Plans drafted before expression distinctness lack the three elements.

FrozenTestPlan.description: Historical snapshots may predate language, expression and style fields; never backfill evidence.

GenerationCapabilities.description: Workspace provider catalog and non-secret readiness.

GenerationDefaultsView.description:
Effective「生成默认值」. ``source`` is ``workspace`` once an Owner
saved them (``revision`` >= 1), else ``computed`` (``revision`` 0).
``warnings``: ``mock_mode`` (show the bind-a-key banner),
``byok_credential_missing``.

GenerationRecoveryPreview.description:
POST /generation/runs/{id}/recovery-previews and
GET /generation/previews/{id} when purpose is run_recovery.

IdentityProbeResponse.description:
The verified TenantContext, echoed back for the tracer round trip.

Declared only so `generate_openapi.py` can extract a real response
schema from `response_model` — the handler returns a `JSONResponse`
directly, which FastAPI never re-validates against `response_model`, so
this model documents the contract without changing runtime behavior.

ImageBrief.description: English instructions for the image model, separate from strategy prose.

IntakeFailure.description:
Why the intake stopped. ``code`` is stable (``access_denied``,
``timeout``, ``not_product_page``, ``blocked_address``,
``extraction_invalid``, ``credential_unavailable`` ...);
``suggested_action`` tells the UI what to offer
(``paste_text_or_screenshot``, ``check_link``, ``retry`` ...).

IntakeImage.description:
A candidate image. ``gate_state`` is the reference gate's verdict
(``released`` images are ``selectable`` and can be previewed through the
download-intent route); ``role`` is the model's ranking role.

LearningsBasis.description:
The learnings a plan was drafted with (Issue #166): labels of the
winning / losing / not-different values, the snapshot and its evidence
partition; ``explicit`` is true for "按结论生成下一轮".

LibraryEntryDetail.description:
``GET /library/entries/{id}`` and the create/save/archive/fork/clone result.

``revision`` tracks the entry's open Draft (defaults to 1 once archived
and the Draft has been dropped) and is the value clients must echo back
via ``If-Match`` on the next mutating command.

LibraryEntryTypeList.description:
``GET /library/entry-types`` -- service.contracts.iter_entry_types() is a
flat sorted list of type keys (e.g. "product", "person"), not objects.

LibraryVersionDetail.description:
``GET /library/versions/{id}`` and the publish/withdraw command result.

Versions are immutable once published (no draft-style revision counter),
so there is no ``revision``/If-Match contract here -- ``version_no`` is
informational only. ``allowed_actions`` is server-computed.

LocalizationConfigurationVersion.description:
A published, non-secret LibraryVersion usable by Localization.

The workspace projection exposes identity, display metadata and the
published policy's non-secret fact requirements. Adapter credentials
remain behind the domain/KMS boundary.

ManualResultRow.description:
One ad's results over a date range. Identify the image by its asset
code (``MK-XXXXXX``, from the template), an ad name containing that
code, or a Meta ``ad_id`` bound to it. ``clicks`` are link clicks.

MaximumCost.description: Cost ceiling for a preview, expressed as a Decimal string with currency.

MetaModeRequest.description:
Body for POST routes that otherwise carry no payload but still need
to bind the request to a Meta mode (see `_effective_context` below).

MetricComparison.description:
One metric of one value (or direction) against the rest.

``estimate`` / ``interval_*``: the value's own rate (CTR: Wilson; CPA:
seeded bootstrap). ``lift*``: ratio to the pooled other values minus
one, with the 95% interval (Bonferroni within the factor); for CPA a
negative lift is better. ``reasons`` explain ``insufficient_data``.

MetricsIssue.description: One preflight finding; the browser words it from ``code`` (#255).

ModelVariant.description:
One variant the source sells: a model, size or power, or a colour /
appearance edition of the same model (Issue #192). ``specs`` are only the
specs that differ; ``appearance`` are its own must-match items (colour,
material, pattern) and ``replaces_must_match_ids`` the shared items they
supersede once it is chosen; ``image_ids`` are the candidate images that
show it (an image no variant claims is general), and
``default_image_ids`` what the card preselects when it is chosen: its
own and the general images, never another variant's.

OperationAccepted.description: 202 Accepted envelope for async domain commands (connection-checks, manual-fact-imports, reference-gate).

OperationDetailResponse.description:
Declared only so `generate_openapi.py` can extract a real response
schema (see the identical note on `IdentityProbeResponse`); the handler
returns a `JSONResponse` directly, so this documents the contract
without changing runtime behavior.

OperationRef.description: ``POST /generation/runs`` result: the Operation created by Atomic Submission.

OperationResultRefResponse.description: Resource type + id (spec §5.1) -- never a URL the browser could not resolve.

PairedQCWaiting.description: An image whose paired check waits for usable images of these counterpart combinations.

PreviewItemSummary.description:
Per-combination detail inside a resolved preview.

``stable_dimension_signature`` (Issue #49 Task 8) is the combination's
dimension-only fingerprint -- the identity Loser exclusion matches
against a signature's newest produced AssetVersion.

ProductCardDraft.description:
The AI's first draft. Every field is editable on confirm; ``must_match``
items carry ``proposed_by: "ai"`` and ``confirmed: false`` until then.

ProductCardEdits.description: The user's edits; an omitted field keeps the AI draft's value.

ProductCompetitorSettings.description:
Whether drafting cites the latest competitor snapshot of the plan's
market (spec §7.2; on unless a member turned it off).

ProductIntakeAccepted.description:
202: the intake and the Operation to poll (``GET /operations/{id}``)
-- or ``GET /products/intake/{intake_id}`` for the card itself.
``replayed`` is true when the same input (within 24 h) or the same
Idempotency-Key returned an existing intake.

ProductIntakeConfirmRequest.description:
Confirm (and publish) the card. ``selected_variant`` is required when
the draft has more than one ``model_variants`` entry; only that variant
enters the version. ``image_ids`` defaults to the chosen variant's
``default_image_ids`` (``card.default_image_ids`` without variants);
an omitted ``card.must_match`` defaults to the shared items plus the
chosen variant's ``appearance``, and an omitted ``card.specs`` to the
shared specs with the variant's laid over them. ``entry_id`` updates an
existing product instead of creating one.

ProductIntakeCreateRequest.description:
At least one of ``url``, ``upload_intent_ids`` (finalized uploads of
purpose ``product_intake_image``) or ``text``.

ProductIntakeDetail.description:
``status``: ``queued`` -> ``fetching`` -> ``extracting`` ->
``preparing_images`` -> ``ready`` (card available) -> ``confirmed``;
or ``fetch_failed`` / ``extraction_failed`` / ``failed`` with
``failure``. ``evidence`` holds per-step outcome, duration and digests.

ProductLatestRun.description: The product's most recent Generation Run, summarized for the home card.

ProductLearnings.description:
「这个产品我们已经学到了什么」. ``status`` ``no_data`` (show
"尚无投放数据" and ``review_signals``) or ``ready``. ``evidence_mode``
is the partition shown (production first); ``evidence_notice`` must be
displayed when present (demo data). ``rounds`` newest first.

ProductReferenceSet.description:
A projection of the product's immutable Library version/bindings.

``revision`` is the If-Match value for edits. Deleted items remain in
prior ProductVersions; ``version_id`` can be frozen by later consumers.

PromoteReferenceBindInput.description:
Every field but ``entry_id`` is nullable without a default: the server
fills the defaults (``service.PROMOTE_DEFAULT_PURPOSE`` / ``_VIEWPOINT``,
priority 0, empty note/conditions), and the generated TypeScript type stays
optional so the automatic post-upload bind sends only the entry id.

QcCheckSummary.description: Individual QC check result (``verdict`` since Issue #169).

QcResultSummary.description: Latest QC attempt state and check results for a RunItem.

ReferenceDownloadGrant.description:
201 response for ``POST /versions/{id}/download-intent``.

``download_url`` is a short-lived signed capability issued by the
``BlobStore`` adapter for the controlled derivative -- the browser opens it
directly against the storage origin (``NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETAI_STORAGE_ORIGINS``),
exactly like generated-asset downloads; it never transits FastAPI or Next.js.

ReferenceObjectDetail.description:
``GET /library/reference-objects/{id}``: gate evidence for one object.

``failure_code`` is the stable code the browser keys its copy on when the
gate Operation failed (``content_safety_unavailable`` means the deployment
selected ``real`` content safety without an adapter -- the object is still
``quarantined``, not rejected). Object keys and signed URLs never appear
here.

ReferencePromotionResult.description:
201 response for ``POST /library/reference-objects/{id}/promote``.

``created`` is false when the object had already been promoted: the same
entry and its current effective version are returned instead of a second
publication. ``binding`` describes the product/person Draft the version
was appended to when ``bind`` was requested.

ReferenceRightsDeclarationInput.description:
The uploader's rights declaration (contract §7.2: 权利状态、授权范围、
有效期和操作者声明). ``state`` is always ``granted`` and ``declared_by`` is
always the current initiator -- neither is accepted from the client.

RegenerationDraftBatchItem.description:
One created Draft in a review-summary batch result (Issue #49 Task 7):
the Draft id, the source AssetVersion chosen for its
stable-dimension-signature group, that group's signature, and the
variant count the batch action requested for it (2 for
``regenerate_needs_changes``, 3 for ``supplement_approved``).

RegenerationDraftBatchResult.description:
``POST /generation/regeneration-draft-batches`` result (Issue #49
Task 7, spec §0.3/§0.4). Browser Task 10's ``ReviewSummary`` consumes
this.

RenderedText.description: The headline and body text as the image renders them, transcribed verbatim; empty when not shown or unreadable.

RenderedTextDifference.description: One copy field whose verbatim transcription differs from the confirmed text, or was not transcribed (`rendered` empty).

ResultsImportCreateRequest.description:
``csv``: exactly one of ``csv_text`` (a pasted table or a small file
read by the browser, <= 300,000 characters) or ``upload_intent_id`` (a
finalized ``results_import`` upload, <= 10 MB, <= 5,000 rows).
``manual``: ``rows`` (<= 2,000).
``meta_sync``: nothing else -- the synced Meta metrics of ads bound to
this product's images. ``currency`` applies to rows without one.

ResultsImportSummary.description:
Counts by row status (``ready`` / ``replaces`` / ``unattributable``
import; ``rejected`` does not), why rows were rejected, rows per
evidence partition, and which columns were read or ignored.

ResultsImportView.description:
A previewed (``previewed``) or committed (``committed``) import.
``rows`` lists every rejected row and the first accepted ones
(``rows_truncated``); ``duplicate`` is true when the same rows were
already imported for this product (the existing import is returned).

ResultsTemplate.description:
The CSV template: ``columns`` in order and one row per image of the
product (code + what it shows); the browser writes the file.

ReviewItem.description: A pre-generation finding. System items are recomputed deterministically.

ReviewObservation.description: A competitor observation a system finding points at: what others publicly run, never evidence (ADR 0014).

ReviewSignals.description:
Human review counts per value of the latest round -- a weak signal
shown only while there is no ad data.

RightsDeclaration.description:
Who made the images and the uploader's confirmation that the
Workspace may use them in ads (``permission_confirmed`` must be true).

RoundLearning.description: One test plan's results ("第 N 轮").

RunCommandResult.description: Result of a Run mutation command (cancel/retry/resume/reconcile).

StageCounts.description:
One scale's planner output priced with the current defaults:
``images = combinations x variants``; ``max_cost`` is 0 under Mock.

StrategyApplied.description:
The combination strategy the planner actually applied (Issue #157).

``kind`` is ``full`` or ``coverage``; ``cap`` is set for ``coverage``.
``deprecated_shape`` is ``True`` when the Draft still carries the legacy
``{mode, sample_cap}`` shape the server mapped onto ``kind``/``cap``.
``full_count`` is the Cartesian product, ``candidate_count`` what was
left after template constraints and exclusion rules, ``selected_count``
what sampling kept (equals ``combination_count`` unless Loser exclusion
removed more).

SuggestedTag.description: The model's pick for one factor: ``value_id`` null means "none of these".

TestPlanCreateRequest.description:
The three questions (contract §3.2), each with a default: ``goal``
``explore``; ``audience_card_index`` the product's first audience card
(or ``audience_text`` to word it yourself); ``scale`` ``sample``.
``optimize`` needs 1-10 ``seed_asset_version_ids`` (Approved assets or
Winners of this Workspace).

TestPlanDetail.description:
``status``: ``drafting`` (poll ``operation_id``) -> ``ready`` or
``failed``. ``stages`` has ``sample`` / ``small`` / ``full`` counts and
max cost; ``selected_stage`` is the plan's own scale; ``expansion`` is
what "展开完整测试" would cost now; ``runs`` are the linked Runs.

TestPlanResults.description: One plan's round of the latest snapshot (directions with metrics).

TestPlanReviseRequest.description:
Remove / restore / edit / add directions and optionally change the
scale; the plan is re-planned and its counts and cost updated.

TestPlanRunRequest.description:
``sample``: one combination per direction. ``full``: the plan's
small/full selection (``full`` when the plan's scale is ``sample``),
skipping combinations the sample Run already produced.

TestPlanRunView.description:
A plan stage's Run. ``status``: ``materializing`` -> ``submitted``
(or ``failed``, retryable by replaying the stage). ``run_status`` and
``items_*`` mirror the GenerationRun; poll ``operation_id`` through
``GET /operations/{id}`` or the Run through ``GET /generation/runs/{id}``.

UntestedSummary.description: Combinations a scale does not generate (shown on the plan card).

UploadIntentResponse.description:
Declared only so `generate_openapi.py` can extract a real response
schema (see the identical note on `IdentityProbeResponse`); the handler
returns a `JSONResponse` directly.

ValueLearning.description:
A factor value: headline ``verdict`` on ``verdict_metric`` and the
one-line ``sentence``; both metrics in full.

VocabularyFactor.description:
A factor of the product's vocabulary. ``source`` is ``test_plan``
(merged across the product's test plans by key),
``dimension_template`` or ``expression_catalog`` (the expression
mechanism catalog, one factor every product has; Issue #329).

app__generation__response_models__Downlo.description:
Shared shape for asset-version/export download-intent results.

``download_grant`` is optional because the export-package route
(``create_generation_export_download_intent``) does not yet issue one
(Issue #49 Task 9 wires that); the asset-version route always populates
it.

app__main__DownloadIntentResponse.description:
See the note on `UploadIntentResponse` -- the handler returns a
`JSONResponse` directly.
